question: H, N, P, T, W and Y live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on and the topmost floor is numbered 6. H lives on one of the floors above floor number 4. Only three people live between H and N. P lives immediately above N. Only three people live between P and T. W lives on one of the odd-numbered floors below T. Who lives immediately above Y?
